candidate_completeness: All triangles in the saved mesh; a closed AABB BVH self-traversal enumerates every overlapping triangle-box pair once. No MeshLab selection filter.
arithmetic: All binary64 representations of saved coordinates decoded exactly to integers with a common power of two. GMP arbitrary-precision integer orientations and rational intersection comparisons, without geometric tolerance.
adjacency: Only an intersection wholly contained in the exact shared vertex or shared edge is normal. Other intersections remain failures, including those in a pair that shares one vertex.
